plan.notes: Source: Fashion Institute of Technology (SUNY) official online catalog, "Fashion Design AAS Degree Program" Plan of Study, "Curriculum below is for the entering class of fall 2026" (catalog.fitnyc.edu). Transcribed exactly as published: 18 + 17.5 + 15.5 + 12.5 = 63.5, matching the published "Total Credits: 63.5" (published area totals: Art History 6 + General Education 18 + Major Area 35 + Related Area 4.5 = 63.5). Semester 4 transcribes the Apparel Specialization (FD 227 + FD 244 + FF 212 = 6.5 credits); the Art Specialization alternative (FD 244 + FF 213 Model Visualization Techniques + FF 244 Design Collections: Visual Solutions + FF 291 Fashion Portfolio Collection = 6.5) is documented in the FD 227 note. General Education / Art History "choice" rows transcribed as choice slots with the Fall 2026 liberal-arts requirement structure documented in each note; the plan's 6-credit gen-ed rows are split into two 3-credit slots (FIT gen-ed courses are 3 credits each), disclosed in the notes. Course titles and credit values (including 1.5-credit studio courses) verified against the catalog page. Evening/Weekend and international (Florence/SUNY Korea) options exist but are not transcribed. AAS = 2-year degree (2YR badge).
